summary: Such an important piece by @Bali_Maha in her model the relationship, knowledge, and labor a transaction amongst two. But what of the space? Can we gift to there in thanks to those who shared before us? Is the real brokering of knowledge even between people?
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Such an important piece by @Bali_Maha in her model the relationship, knowledge, and labor a transaction amongst two. But what of the space? Can we gift to there in thanks to those who shared before us?

Is the real brokering of knowledge even between people?
